system.description: A Focus for studying a mystical power that unites all things across galactic distances.

abilities.name: Defensive Precognition
abilities.description: Automatically dodge ranged attacks, but hinder your other actions on the next turn after being attacked from range.

abilities.name: Push
abilities.description: Telekinetically push a visible creature your size or smaller an immediate distance within short range.

abilities.name: Use the Force
abilities.description: Gain an asset on one noncombat task this turn; you cannot use this ability again until a recovery action.

abilities.name: Telepathic Message
abilities.description: Send a one-way telepathic message to a target you have seen on the same planet, extending its range with Effort.

abilities.name: Desperate Feat
abilities.description: While you have a moderate or major wound, gain 1 Edge in a Pool of your choice.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.description: Telekinetically manipulate a visible object within long range over one round, including moving or hindering a creature.

abilities.name: Psychic Suggestion
abilities.description: On a successful Intellect attack, make a nearby target take an indicated action on its next turn.

abilities.name: Acrobatic Attack
abilities.description: Leap into an attack and gain a free Effort level when spending Effort on the attack roll; a natural 17 or 18 can produce a minor effect instead of extra damage.

abilities.name: Unbalancing Strike
abilities.description: Make an eased melee attack that hinders all of the target’s actions on its next turn if it hits.

abilities.name: Telekinetic Crush
abilities.description: Make a hindered Intellect attack against a nonliving foe to crush it for 6 damage.

abilities.name: Total Awareness
abilities.description: Your special senses make you difficult to surprise or hide from, and Effort on initiative or perception gains two free levels.

abilities.name: Telekinetic Throw
abilities.description: Hurl an object at a nearby target with an Intellect attack to deal 6 damage on a hit.

abilities.name: Lethal Capability
abilities.description: Choose a specific attack type to deal 5 additional damage; you can select this ability more than once with a different attack each time.

abilities.name: Return to Sender
abilities.description: After successfully blocking or dodging a melee attack, immediately make a melee attack against the attacker.
